player: A luminous cyan water-drop avatar near the lower screen; its lateral movement remains easy to track against the dark field.
forwardMotion: Automatic forward travel is clearly conveyed by the perspective grid, lane posts, and approaching objects growing and sliding downward. Lateral steering reads separately from forward motion.
actions: Steer left to pass through the yellow ring
Remain left to avoid the coral polygon obstacle
Steer back toward the green three-leaf life form
Trigger an expanding pulse while close to the life form
goal: Guide the droplet through a three-part sequence—RING, DODGE, and PULSE—before the countdown expires, culminating in transferring light to the green life form.
result: All three tasks visibly complete and the run ends with an unmistakable centered 3/3 CLEAR panel. No material gameplay/UI overlap obscures the player or objectives.
progress: The upper-left checklist changes from pending to completed states, the lower-left counter advances from 0/3 to 3/3, and the upper-right timer counts down from 14 seconds. The final modal clearly confirms completion.

failures.observation: The coral obstacle and the farther green life form initially project onto nearly the same line and briefly read as one sprouted object; their separate roles become clear only as forward motion separates them.
failures.fixFirst: Offset the life form laterally or add a depth/lane cue so the obstacle and later target read as separate silhouettes immediately.

failures.observation: Ring and dodge success are communicated mainly by physical passage plus small checklist changes; neither object gives a strong event-local success response.
failures.fixFirst: Add a brief color-independent flash, contour burst, or shape reaction anchored to the ring and obstacle at the success moment.

failures.observation: The expanding pulse clearly communicates the action and overlaps the life form, but the life form itself shows little persistent visual change, so the transferred-light result depends on reading the checklist.
failures.fixFirst: Make the life form visibly bloom, brighten, grow, or change silhouette immediately after the pulse reaches it.

failures.observation: The title and timer dominate appropriately, but checklist results, controls, and lower diagnostics are small and low-contrast at native 1080p viewing distance.
failures.fixFirst: Increase the size and contrast of actionable status text while further de-emphasizing diagnostic labels.
